title: AI & LLM: What Large Language Models Actually Do
excerpt: A practical introduction to large language models, how they process prompts, and where they are useful.
content:
# AI & LLM: What Large Language Models Actually Do

Large Language Models are AI systems trained on large collections of text. They generate responses by combining learned language patterns with the context supplied in a prompt.

## How they work

A prompt is converted into tokens. Transformer-based attention mechanisms use the surrounding context to estimate useful next tokens and construct a response.

## Better prompts

Clear prompts usually specify the goal, audience, context, constraints, and desired output format.

## Practical uses

Common uses include drafting, summarization, translation, coding assistance, research organization, customer support, and content preparation.

## Verify important output

AI output should be checked when accuracy, current information, or source attribution matters.

## Key takeaway

Useful AI results depend on the model, context, instructions, verification, and the workflow around them.
